settings.heading: Where Ancient Loom Traditions Meet Contemporary Grace
settings.quote: Eighteen stitches in every inch—a master weaver's testament to patience, human hands, and conscious luxury.
settings.text:
18 Stitches was founded with an unyielding reverence for India's living textile heritage. In a world dominated by rapid consumption and synthetic fibers, our atelier champions the deliberate art of slow fashion.

We collaborate directly with generational weavers in Chanderi, Varanasi, and Maheshwar, bringing together age-old artisanal weaves with minimalist silhouettes tailored for the contemporary woman.

Every garment is produced in strictly limited editions of 15 to 30 pieces, ensuring mindful production without waste, and creating timeless heirlooms meant to be cherished across celebrations.
settings.signature_sub: Handcrafted in India • Designed for Eternity
